Giải đơn phong trào dành cho người chơi: A recreational singles event for players aged 18 and over. Challenge yourself and meet the Courtly community.
Lịch, phí và điều lệ là đề xuất cho bản: Dates, fees and rules are proposals for this demo, not an official event announcement.
Giờ từng trận sẽ được xác nhận sau khi c: Individual match times will be confirmed after entries close and the draw is made.
Người chơi phong trào từ 18 tuổi, đăng k: Recreational players aged 18 and over enter individually in one open category. A 16-player knockout draw starts in the round of 16. No third-place match. The draw follows the registration deadline.
Mỗi trận một set đến 6 game, cách biệt 2: One set to 6 games, with a two-game lead. At 6–6, play a tie-break to 7 points with a two-point lead. Standard games use advantage scoring at deuce. Up to 5 minutes of warm-up before each match.
200.000đ / người, gồm sân thi đấu, bóng: 200,000 VND per player, including match courts, match balls and scheduled referees. A winner’s trophy and runner-up medal are proposed. No cash prize is included. Membership discounts do not apply to event entry fees.
Có mặt lúc 07:30, mang giấy tờ đối chiếu: Check in at 07:30 with ID and suitable tennis shoes. Arriving more than 15 minutes after the match call may result in a walkover. Withdraw before the entry deadline for a full refund of fees paid; later withdrawals are non-refundable. An organiser cancellation receives a full refund. If dates change, players may keep their entry or request a refund.
Trọng tài điều hành và ghi nhận điểm. Th: Referees manage play and record scores. Raise a query before the next point; the event director may review it if needed. Respect opponents and avoid disruptive or dangerous behaviour. A backup schedule is proposed for court disruptions; players will be informed before confirming any new dates.
Giải đôi phong trào dành cho hai người b: A recreational doubles event for a pair who love playing together. Enter as a team in one open category, including men’s, women’s and mixed pairs.
Mỗi đội có 2 người chơi phong trào từ 18: Two recreational players aged 18 and over per team; all pairings are welcome. An 8-team knockout draw starts in the quarter-finals, with no third-place match. Players may enter only one team in this doubles event. Partner changes before the entry deadline require organiser approval.
Mỗi trận một set đến 6 game, cách biệt 2: One set to 6 games, with a two-game lead. At 6–6, play a tie-break to 7 points with a two-point lead. No-ad scoring: at deuce, play one deciding point and the receiving team chooses the receiving side. Up to 5 minutes of warm-up before each match.
300.000đ / đội, gồm sân thi đấu, bóng th: 300,000 VND per team, including match courts, match balls and scheduled referees. A winning team trophy and runner-up medals are proposed. No cash prize is included. Membership discounts do not apply to event entry fees.
Cả hai thành viên có mặt lúc 07:30, mang: Both players must check in at 07:30 with ID and suitable tennis shoes. A team missing a player more than 15 minutes after the match call may receive a walkover loss. Withdraw before the entry deadline for a full refund of fees paid; later withdrawals are non-refundable. An organiser cancellation receives a full refund. If dates change, teams may keep their entry or request a refund.
Trọng tài điều hành và ghi nhận điểm. Th: Referees manage play and record scores. Raise a query before the next point; the event director may review it if needed. Respect opponents and avoid disruptive or dangerous behaviour. A backup schedule is proposed for court disruptions; teams will be informed before confirming any new dates.
